title: Juniper and the Regiment
author: Mirabel Villalobos
blurb: Ines Sandoval, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
